name: SubPro II
tagline: High-Speed Industrial Roll-to-Roll Dye Sublimation Printer

keySpecification.description: Advanced industrial textile printing technology designed to maximize productivity, ensure superior color accuracy, and support diverse fabric applications.

rows.label: Ink Colors
rows.value: Up to 12 (CMYK + Lc + Lm + Fl. Yellow + Fl. Pink + Turquoise + options)

inkCompatibility.description: Designed to support multiple ink technologies, offering flexibility for various fabric types while maintaining exceptional print quality and durability.

inkTypes.name: Sublimation
inkTypes.fabrics: Polyester · Synthetic Blends · Transfer Paper for heat press transfer to polyester fabrics

inkTypes.name: Extended Color Options
inkTypes.fabrics: Light Cyan · Light Magenta · Fluorescent Yellow · Fluorescent Pink · Turquoise for wide-gamut specialty and sportswear output

features.description: Engineered with smart automation and precision technology for reliable, efficient, and high-performance textile printing

items.title: 8 Kyocera Printheads with Single or Dual Channel Option
items.desc: Flexible Kyocera printhead configuration in single or dual channel allows operators to choose between maximum speed in 1-pass mode and higher quality in multi-pass mode based on order requirements.

items.title: High-Speed 1-Pass Production at 400 x 600 dpi
items.desc: 1-pass configuration at 400 x 600 dpi delivers top-end daily throughput for cost-conscious large-volume sublimation operations where speed and output per shift are the primary performance metrics.

items.title: Ultra-Thin Paper Compatibility
items.desc: Engineered to print reliably on lightweight and ultra-thin sublimation transfer papers, significantly reducing per-metre media cost without sacrificing colour accuracy or transfer quality.

items.title: Constant Temperature Hot Air Dryer
items.desc: Precision hot air drying system maintains a stable, uniform temperature across the full print width, ensuring consistent ink fixation, wrinkle-free media output, and high-definition transfer results.

items.title: Up to 12-Colour Ink Support
items.desc: Optional extended colour channels including light cyan, light magenta, fluorescent yellow, fluorescent pink, and turquoise expand the printable gamut for sportswear, swimwear, and premium fashion applications.

items.title: 15-Litre Bulk Ink Tanks
items.desc: High-capacity 15-litre per colour ink tanks significantly reduce refill frequency, supporting extended uninterrupted production shifts and lowering operator workload on high-volume order runs.

items.title: Jumbo Roll Support
items.desc: Built for non-stop mass production with jumbo roll compatibility that minimises media change frequency and allows sustained operation with minimal operator intervention.

items.title: Compact Industrial-Ready Footprint
items.desc: 4,500 mm x 4,500 mm site footprint delivers full industrial-scale sublimation output without requiring large dedicated floor space, making the SubPro II practical for space-conscious factory environments.

idealFor.description: Perfectly suited for a wide range of textile applications, delivering exceptional print quality, color vibrancy, and production efficiency across diverse fabric categories.

fabrics.title: High-Volume Sublimation Transfer Paper Production
fabrics.desc: Fast 1-pass output at up to 7,100 lm/day makes the SubPro II one of the most cost-efficient choices for manufacturers supplying large volumes of printed paper to heat press operations at scale.

fabrics.title: Cost-Optimised Polyester Fashion Fabric Printing
fabrics.desc: Ultra-thin paper compatibility reduces media cost per metre, making the SubPro II the preferred choice for price-sensitive wholesale polyester fabric producers competing on output cost efficiency.

fabrics.title: Sportswear and Activewear with Extended Colour Gamut
fabrics.desc: Fluorescent and extended colour channel support makes the SubPro II especially well suited to sportswear brands, swim wear manufacturers, and activewear producers requiring vivid fluorescent output.

fabrics.title: Large-Scale Polyester Home Textile Production
fabrics.desc: High-capacity sublimation on polyester curtains, cushion covers, upholstery, and decorative soft furnishings for domestic and export home textile markets requiring reliable daily output.

fabrics.title: Job Work and Multi-Buyer Sublimation Operations
fabrics.desc: High throughput, flexible colour configuration, and low media cost make the SubPro II a strong choice for large job work printers managing diverse clients with varying colour and volume requirements.

fabrics.title: Space-Constrained Industrial Production Facilities
fabrics.desc: Compact 4,500 mm x 4,500 mm site footprint makes the SubPro II suitable for manufacturers who need industrial output capacity without dedicating large floor space to a single machine.

fabrics.title: Promotional and Custom Polyester Printing
fabrics.desc: Fast setup, versatile colour options, and jumbo roll support suit custom polyester printing for corporate branding, event merchandise, and promotional textile production at volume.

productionCapacity.description: Choose the ideal speed and resolution combination to optimize production output and print performance.

globalComponents.description: Built using premium international components that deliver superior accuracy, durability, and consistent production efficiency.

smallCards.title: Up to 12-Colour Ink Configuration

smallCards.title: RIP Software — neoStampa Professional Edition
smallCards.desc: Industry-standard RIP with ICC colour management, extended gamut support, Pantone library, job queuing, and complete production workflow tools
